name: naruto-d20-kaihou
description: Kaihou-specific identity content module for Foundry VTT (Naruto D20).

scripts.pack:villages: node node_modules/@foundryvtt/foundryvtt-cli/fvtt.mjs package pack --id naruto-d20-kaihou --type Module --compendiumName villages --in packs/_source/villages --out packs
scripts.pack:questions: node node_modules/@foundryvtt/foundryvtt-cli/fvtt.mjs package pack --id naruto-d20-kaihou --type Module --compendiumName questions --in packs/_source/questions --out packs
scripts.pack:schools: node node_modules/@foundryvtt/foundryvtt-cli/fvtt.mjs package pack --id naruto-d20-kaihou --type Module --compendiumName schools --in packs/_source/schools --out packs
scripts.pack:occupations: node node_modules/@foundryvtt/foundryvtt-cli/fvtt.mjs package pack --id naruto-d20-kaihou --type Module --compendiumName occupations --in packs/_source/occupations --out packs --recursive
scripts.pack:all: npm run pack:villages && npm run pack:questions && npm run pack:schools && npm run pack:occupations
scripts.unpack:villages: node node_modules/@foundryvtt/foundryvtt-cli/fvtt.mjs package unpack --id naruto-d20-kaihou --type Module --compendiumName villages --in packs --out packs/_source/villages
scripts.unpack:questions: node node_modules/@foundryvtt/foundryvtt-cli/fvtt.mjs package unpack --id naruto-d20-kaihou --type Module --compendiumName questions --in packs --out packs/_source/questions
scripts.unpack:schools: node node_modules/@foundryvtt/foundryvtt-cli/fvtt.mjs package unpack --id naruto-d20-kaihou --type Module --compendiumName schools --in packs --out packs/_source/schools
scripts.unpack:occupations: node node_modules/@foundryvtt/foundryvtt-cli/fvtt.mjs package unpack --id naruto-d20-kaihou --type Module --compendiumName occupations --in packs --out packs/_source/occupations --folders
scripts.unpack:all: npm run unpack:villages && npm run unpack:questions && npm run unpack:schools && npm run unpack:occupations
scripts.lint:js: eslint --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern scripts tools tests eslint.config.mjs vitest.config.mjs
scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:css && npm run lint:format
scripts.lint:fix: eslint --fix --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern scripts tools eslint.config.mjs && node node_modules/stylelint/bin/stylelint.mjs --fix "styles/**/*.css" && prettier --write "eslint.config.mjs" "lang/**/*.json"
scripts.test: python3 -m pytest tests/ -v && npm run test:js && npm run test:css-fresh
scripts.build:css: sass scss/kaihou.scss styles/theme/zen.css --style=compressed --no-source-map --load-path=scss && sass scss/apps/_twenty-questions-wizard.scss styles/apps/twenty-questions-wizard.css --style=compressed --no-source-map --load-path=scss
scripts.build: npm run pack:all && npm run build:css
scripts.test:css-fresh: npm run build:css --silent && git diff --quiet styles/ || (echo 'CSS out of date - run npm run build:css and commit' && exit 1)
